input.title: Ensure header row with quoted names is processed correctly
input.body:
File: src/i18n/en.json

Modify the CSV import logic so that it correctly handles header rows where the column names are enclosed in double quotes. Currently, this causes an incorrect column count mismatch error as evidenced by the reporter needing to manually remove the quotes from the header row to successfully import a file. This change will allow files exported with quoted headers to be imported without modification, aligning our parser with common CSV conventions.

Thus, the pull request should be focused on addressing this particular issue in the code responsible for importing CSV files.

Title: Ensure header row with quoted names is processed correctly

Body: 
```
File: src/i18n/en.json

Modify the CSV import logic so that it correctly handles header rows where the column names are enclosed in double quotes. Currently, this causes an incorrect column count mismatch error as evidenced by the reporter needing to manually remove the quotes from the header row to successfully import a file. This change will allow files exported with quoted headers to be imported without modification, aligning our parser with common CSV conventions.
```

input.title: Ensure header row with quoted names is processed correctly
input.body:
File: src/i18n/en.json

Modify the CSV import logic so that it correctly handles header rows where the column names are enclosed in double quotes. Currently, this causes an incorrect column count mismatch error as evidenced by the reporter needing to manually remove the quotes from the header row to successfully import a file. This change will allow files exported with quoted headers to be imported without modification, aligning our parser with common CSV conventions.
